meta: You pasted a whole payroll sheet into AI to work out bonuses, then panicked: where does this data go? What happens to your chats, and what never to paste.

muc.title: A whole payroll sheet
muc.text: Mark pastes his team's whole payroll sheet into AI to work out bonuses, and only afterwards wonders where this data goes.

muc.title: Stored on servers
muc.text: Bit explains: the conversation is sent to the provider's servers, and is usually saved in your history.

muc.title: It may be used for training
muc.text: With personal accounts, many apps can use your chats to train new models unless you turn it off. Settings usually has a switch for this, under privacy or data controls.

muc.title: Things you shouldn't paste
muc.text: Never paste passwords, OTP codes, ID numbers, customer data or company secrets into a personal AI account.

muc.title: Hide details before pasting
muc.text: The safe way: hide details before pasting, and replace real names with Employee A, B, C. AI still calculates correctly without knowing who's who. Use temporary chat mode, or a company account that promises not to use data for training.

muc.title: Open Settings now
muc.text: Open Settings in the AI app you use, find privacy or data controls, and choose whether your data can be used for training.
